services.desc: Select ready-made bisqueware and enjoy giving them your own creative touch by painting them with glaze. We will guide you in this process, dip them in clear glaze and fire them in our kiln. You will need to come back to pick up the work. please email karen@albanyartroom.com to schedule the date before you pay for this private
